categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of ultrasonic welding, cutting equipment, and accessories. It also provides automation solutions for the new energy power battery manufacturing sector. Key product lines include ultrasonic welding machines for power batteries, automotive wire harnesses, semiconductor welding equipment, ultrasonic cutting machines for automotive tires, and related inspection devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed a comprehensive ultrasonic technology platform encompassing ultrasonic power supply technology, piezoelectric transducer simulation design, acoustic tool design, controller development, intelligent online detection, and automation systems. Core innovations include integrated wedge welding technology, ultrasonic metal welding quality monitoring, high-speed rolling welding systems, dual-phase synchronous ultrasonic power technology, and ultrasonic dust removal technology. Production follows a sales-driven model combined with safety stock, with some non-core processes outsourced to qualified external suppliers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading enterprises in the new energy power battery industry (e.g., CATL, BYD), automotive wire harness manufacturers, semiconductor companies, and tire manufacturers (e.g., Goodyear, Hankook). Its products are widely used in lithium battery production lines, automotive high and low voltage wire harnesses, charging piles, energy storage, semiconductor packaging and testing, and automotive tire cutting.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated in China, accounting for over 98% of revenue. It has also begun expanding into overseas markets with subsidiaries such as SBT Ultrasonic Technology (Germany) GmbH. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Shanghai and Wuxi.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the ultrasonic equipment supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of ultrasonic welding and cutting machines and related automation systems. It produces key components in-house and outsources some non-core parts. It supplies equipment directly to downstream manufacturers in battery, automotive, semiconductor, and tire industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology innovation driven by substantial R&D investment, focusing on high-end ultrasonic applications in power batteries, automotive wire harnesses, semiconductors, and non-metal welding. It actively develops advanced packaging equipment for semiconductors and expands ultrasonic applications into new fields such as medical and hydrogen energy. Collaborations with universities and research institutes support its technology leadership. The company also invests in automation and intelligent monitoring systems to enhance product quality and production efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of ultrasonic welding and cutting equipment, automation systems, and related accessories. The company uses a direct sales model with customized solutions for non-standard products and standard product sales based on customer orders. It also earns income from after-sales technical services and ongoing customer support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international leaders such as Branson (Emerson), Telsonic, Sonics, Herrmann, and Sonoscan in ultrasonic equipment markets. While foreign brands dominate high-end segments, the company has been steadily increasing its market share domestically by leveraging its technology platform and local service advantages. It holds a strong position in China’s ultrasonic welding equipment market, especially in power batteries, automotive wire harnesses, and semiconductor applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 525 million, a slight increase of 0.52% year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 66.5 million, down 39.97% due to increased R&D and sales expenses. Total assets reached RMB 2.17 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.75 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with R&D expenses accounting for 22.36% of revenue in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers advanced ultrasonic technology solutions with superior welding quality, stability, and efficiency compared to traditional methods. Its integrated ultrasonic systems provide real-time quality monitoring and intelligent control, enhancing production reliability. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, a comprehensive ultrasonic technology platform, rapid product iteration, and localized high-quality customer service, enabling it to meet the stringent requirements of leading customers in new energy, automotive, semiconductor, and tire industries.
